vendor: TPS Unlimited, Inc. (d/b/a TaxJar, a Stripe company)
product_family: Cloud-based sales tax compliance platform covering real-time tax calculation, nexus tracking, AutoFile filing/remittance, reporting, and a REST API; sold to small/mid-market e-commerce and SaaS sellers and integrated into Amazon, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Stripe Tax. Acquired by Stripe in 2021; the underlying legal entity remains TPS Unlimited, Inc.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: TaxJar recently underwent a rigorous, voluntary year-long SOC 2, Type 2 audit completed by the independent CPA firm Shellman & Company.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type I
certifications.proof_quote: Point-in-time SOC 2 Type 1 audit completed February 2020, preceding the year-long Type 2 evaluation.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification; not listed among the certification badges on TaxJar's own security page (which shows only SOC 2, GDPR, and a Cloud Security Alliance badge).

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: "GDPR Compliant" badge is displayed in the Compliance/privacy certifications & regulations section of the security page; the Privacy Policy separately commits to EU Standard Contractual Clauses for cross-border transfers covering EEA, UK, and Swiss residents.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of HIPAA or Business Associate Agreements anywhere on the vendor's security or privacy pages; product handles transaction/tax data, not protected health information, so HIPAA is out of scope.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification on vendor-owned pages. TaxJar calculates/files sales tax and does not itself process cardholder payment data (that is handled by the seller's payment processor, e.g. Stripe).

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: The security page displays a "Cloud Security Alliance" badge, but this is not labeled as a CSA STAR certification level (Level 1/2/3), and TaxJar does not appear in the public CSA STAR Registry.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of AI governance certification on any vendor-owned page.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization on vendor-owned pages.

privacy.ai_training_note: The Privacy Policy contains no statement about using customer data to train AI or machine learning models. TaxJar's product markets 'AI-driven categorization' as a feature, but no vendor-owned page describes training generative/ML models on customer tax data, and none discloses an opt-out because no training claim exists to opt out of.
privacy.data_region: United States (Privacy Policy states services are 'hosted in the United States,' with possible processing in other countries where TaxJar or its service providers do business)

security.name: Encryption in transit and at rest
security.value: AES256 encryption at rest, TLS in transit, SHA2 signatures

security.name: Access control
security.value: Least-privilege principle; permission sets reflect job roles

security.name: Monitoring
security.value: Cloud SIEM integrated with AWS security analytics for log/alert aggregation

security.name: Vulnerability management
security.value: External network vulnerability scans, DAST/SAST web application scans, annual penetration testing

security.name: Incident response
security.value: Documented Incident Response & Breach Notification Process covering identification, triage, monitoring, and remediation

security.name: Uptime
security.value: Vendor claims 99.999% historical uptime for transaction tax calculation

products.name: TaxJar Sales Tax Compliance Platform (calculations, filing, reporting)
products.category: Core SaaS product, self-serve and mid-market
products.data_scope: E-commerce order/transaction data, product categorization, buyer location data (city/province/country minimum for non-US calculations)
products.notes: Primary product; covered by the SOC 2 Type II audit and the GDPR/security posture described above.

products.name: Sales Tax API
products.data_scope: Per-transaction data submitted via API call for real-time rate/tax calculation
products.notes: Same infrastructure and compliance posture as the core platform per TaxJar's security page; no separate certification scope was found.

products.name: TaxJar & Stripe Tax integration
products.data_scope: Transaction data shared between Stripe Tax and TaxJar for joint customers
products.notes: TaxJar operates as a Stripe company; the Privacy Policy has a dedicated 'TaxJar & Stripe Tax' section. TaxJar's SOC 2 certification is separate from Stripe's own PCI DSS Level 1 status, which applies to Stripe's payment processing, not to TaxJar's tax platform.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription tiers (free 30-day trial, paid plans by transaction volume) plus AutoFile add-on per state

flags: No dedicated third-party trust-center portal (e.g. Vanta/Drata/SafeBase) was found; compliance info lives on a standard marketing 'Security' page rather than a live, continuously-updated trust center, so has_trust_center is set to false.
The 'Cloud Security Alliance' badge on the security page is ambiguous: it is not labeled as a specific CSA STAR certification level, and TaxJar does not appear in the public CSA STAR Registry.
TaxJar is a Stripe-owned subsidiary (legal entity TPS Unlimited, Inc.); Stripe's own extensive certifications (e.g. PCI DSS Level 1) are not TaxJar's certifications.
AI-training posture is inferred from the absence of any training disclosure, not from an explicit no-training statement.
